verses.en: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor todas as nações, exaltai-o todos os povos.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.en_bbe: Let all the nations give praise to the Lord: let all the people give him praise.

verses.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Porque a sua benignidade é grande para conosco, e a verdade do Senhor dura para sempre. Louvai ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: For great is his mercy to us, and his faith is unchanging for ever. Praise be to the Lord.
